question:
What is the value of p in the following equation?

64 - [16 + {23 - (12 + 10)}] = p
solution:
**Given:**

64 - [16 + {23 - (12 + 10)}] = p

 

Concept used:

Follow the BODMAS rule according to the table given below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/47485e25d1b30c57dc271863db8b99be0c8e209069b2596cc885911d898a8a78.png] 

**Calculation:**

64 - [16 + {23 - (12 + 10)}] = p

⇒ 64 - [16 + {23 - 22}]

⇒ 64 - [16 + 1]

⇒ 64 - 17

⇒ 47

**∴ Option 1 is the correct answer.**
